Class Style

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.style.Style
public final class Style extends Object
A complete style definition including foreground, background, and modifiers. Styles are immutable and composable.

    • implicitStyleNames

      public Set<String> implicitStyleNames()
      Returns the style names implied by this style's Named colors and modifiers.

      Named foreground colors contribute their name (e.g., "red"), Named background colors contribute "bg-" + name (e.g., "bg-red"), and modifiers contribute their Modifier.implicitStyleName() (e.g., "bold").

      Returns:
      an unmodifiable set of implied CSS class names
